testsuite.name: insurance rating — unary + streaming against the RatingService (gRPC)

testcase.name: young-collision-ca — young driver, collision, California — the young-driver loading fires
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * check = Rule.execute('rating', __row) * = 'Rate' * session.send(check.input) * reply = session.pop() * reply contains check.output * check.verify(true, 'the live RatingService agrees with the rulebook')

testcase.name: prior-claims-comprehensive-ny — adult with prior claims, comprehensive, New York — the prior-claims surcharge fires
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * check = Rule.execute('rating', __row) * = 'Rate' * session.send(check.input) * reply = session.pop() * reply contains check.output * check.verify(true, 'the live RatingService agrees with the rulebook')

testcase.name: clean-liability-tx — adult, clean record, liability, Texas — the base case, no loadings
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * check = Rule.execute('rating', __row) * = 'Rate' * session.send(check.input) * reply = session.pop() * reply contains check.output * check.verify(true, 'the live RatingService agrees with the rulebook')

testcase.name: policy classification — the field no oracle can price
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * = 'Rate' * session.send({ state: 'CA', coverage: 'COLLISION', driverAge: 40, priorClaims: false }) * session.pop().policyClass == 'PREFERRED' * session.send({ state: 'CA', coverage: 'COLLISION', driverAge: 40, priorClaims: true }) * session.pop().policyClass == 'SUBSTANDARD'

testcase.name: coverage + driver-age dimensions
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * = 'Rate' * young = { state: 'TX', coverage: 'LIABILITY', driverAge: 19, priorClaims: true } * session.send(young) * youngReply = session.pop() * youngReply contains Rule.execute('rating', young).output * youngReply.policyClass == 'SUBSTANDARD' * adult = { state: 'NY', coverage: 'COLLISION', driverAge: 50, priorClaims: false } * session.send(adult) * adultReply = session.pop() * adultReply contains Rule.execute('rating', adult).output * adultReply.policyClass == 'PREFERRED'

testcase.name: error path — an unsupported state is rejected (rich error details)
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * = 'Rate' * session.send({ state: 'ZZ', coverage: 'LIABILITY', driverAge: 40 }) * session.collect() == [] * session.status == 'INVALID_ARGUMENT' * session.statusDetails contains { message: 'unsupported state' } * session.statusDetails.details[*] contains deep { reason: 'STATE_UNSUPPORTED', domain: 'rating.karatelabs.io' }

testcase.name: server streaming — term options
testcase.system-out: * session = karate.channel('grpc') * = 'proto/rating.proto' * = 'RatingService' * row = { state: 'WA', coverage: 'COMPREHENSIVE', driverAge: 50, priorClaims: false } * check = Rule.execute('rating', row) * = 'StreamQuotes' * = 3 * session.send(row) * quotes = session.collect() * quotes[0] contains check.output * quotes[1].monthlyPremium < quotes[0].monthlyPremium * quotes[2].monthlyPremium < quotes[1].monthlyPremium * each quotes contains { currency: 'USD', policyClass: '#string' }
